title: 3.1.14 Challenges
description: Three Spinning Sculpture extension challenges: chain a third Cube, drive scale with Math.sin, or add a keyboard freeze toggle.

steps.title: Pick a challenge
steps.instructions: Read content.md and choose one (or more) of the three challenges. Each builds on your Spinning Sculpture code.
hints: The auto-grader accepts any of the three challenge signals — pick whichever interests you most.

requirements.title: Spinning Sculpture base present
requirements.description: parent() is still called — the sculpture core is intact.

requirements.title: At least one challenge implemented
requirements.description: Code shows a chained cube (second parent call), Math.sin driving .size, or a frozen/kb.pressing toggle.
